name: Creator advice
when: one person talking to camera with tips, money, growth, opinions or lessons
notes: Graphics follow the sentence's shape: a number counts up, a list builds item by item, 'not X, not Y' becomes cross tiles, a reveal gets one huge keyword on the music drop. Keyword lines only on turning points. Punch in on the key line of every sentence.

name: Interview or podcast clip
when: two or more people talking to each other or to an off-camera host
notes: Keep the exchange that lands hardest. Cut to whoever speaks. Name tags the first time each person appears. Emotional words get a keyword; a question gets a statement card.

name: Talking while cooking or eating
when: someone speaks while making or showing food, a meal, a product or a routine
notes: Each dish or ingredient named gets its icon inside the caption. Cold open on the finished result. The payoff line ('it tastes amazing') is the big moment.

name: Vlog / day in the life
when: a day, trip, routine or event told by the person living it, many places or moments
notes: Pick the 4-6 moments that tell the day. Label places and times. Keep the funniest or most honest line as the hook.

name: Recipe or process, no voice
when: hands making something step by step with no one speaking: cooking, crafts, building, beauty
notes: Hook on the finished result, flash montage, a chapter per step, ingredient tags as they appear, fast-forward repetitive work, slow motion on the money shots, score composed to the cuts.

name: Local business ad
when: a business owner or service: dentist, salon, realtor, gym, shop, agency
notes: Pain, then proof (reviews, years, credentials as ticks and counters), then the offer, then a call to action. Brand colours throughout.

name: Explainer or documentary
when: someone explains how something works, a science fact, history, news or a story
notes: One visual idea per sentence: numbers count up, places get a map, processes become a flow, key terms get a keyword behind the speaker.

name: Product or app demo
when: someone shows a product, gadget or app working
notes: Feature names as tags on the shot that shows them, a checklist of benefits, the result as the payoff.
